description: This file is a Spring Boot REST controller defining basic endpoints for health checks, documentation redirect, and a welcome message.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic endpoints such as welcome message, documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message to clients accessing the root URL.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects clients accessing '/docs' to the Swagger UI page.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Provides a health status check endpoint.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns basic information about the application.
